questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): A school Principal cannot deny admission to a child with a benchmark disability solely on the ground of their disability.
Reason (R): Section 16 of the RPwD Act, 2016 mandates that all educational institutions funded or recognized by the appropriate government must provide inclusive education and admit children with disabilities without discrimination.
In the context of the statements above, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) is the direct statutory justification and correct explanation of Assertion (A).

Section 16 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 provides that the appropriate government and local authorities shall ensure that all educational institutions funded or recognized by them provide inclusive education to children with disabilities. Sub-clause (i) of Section 16 specifically mandates that institutions must 'admit them without discrimination and provide education and opportunities for sports and recreation activities equally with others'.

Therefore, any refusal by a school principal or administrative authority to admit a student on the ground of disability is a direct violation of Section 16, attracting penal consequences under Section 89 and Section 91/92 of the Act. Hence, R correctly explains A.

दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम (RPwD Act), 2016 की धारा 16 समुचित सरकारों और स्थानीय प्राधिकारियों पर यह वैधानिक दायित्व डालती है कि वे अपने द्वारा वित्तपोषित अथवा मान्यता प्राप्त सभी शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में दिव्यांग बच्चों को समावेशी शिक्षा प्रदान करें। धारा 16(i) स्पष्ट आदेश देती है कि शिक्षण संस्थान 'उन्हें बिना किसी भेदभाव के प्रवेश देंगे और दूसरों के समान ही खेल व मनोरंजन गतिविधियों के अवसर तथा शिक्षा प्रदान करेंगे'।

अतः किसी विद्यालय के प्राचार्य द्वारा दिव्यांगता के आधार पर किसी बच्चे को प्रवेश देने से मना करना गैर-कानूनी और दंडनीय है। इस प्रकार, (R) सीधे तौर पर (A) का सही कारण और विधिक आधार स्पष्ट करता है।

questions.question_english: A Principal, acting as the Head of Office (HOO), engages a local contractor for whitewashing and painting the school building. The total value of the contract payment is ₹40,000. Under which section of the Income Tax Act, 1961 is the DDO required to deduct Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)?
options_english: Section 192
Section 194J
Section 194C
Section 194A
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any person responsible for paying any sum to a resident contractor for carrying out any 'work' (including civil construction, repair, whitewashing, painting, or maintenance) in pursuance of a contract is required to deduct tax at source (TDS).

The statutory threshold limits under Section 194C are:
1. A single contract payment exceeding ₹30,000, OR
2. Aggregate payments to the contractor exceeding ₹1,00,000 during the financial year.

Since the contract payment of ₹40,000 exceeds the individual threshold of ₹30,000, the DDO is legally mandated to deduct TDS under Section 194C (at 1% if the contractor is an individual/HUF, or 2% for corporate/other entities).

Other sections:
- Section 192 applies to salaries.
- Section 194J applies to fees for professional or technical services.
- Section 194A applies to interest other than interest on securities.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 194C के तहत, किसी अनुबंध के अनुसरण में किसी भी 'कार्य' (जिसमें भवन निर्माण, मरम्मत, पुताई/सफेदी, पेंटिंग या रखरखाव शामिल है) को पूरा करने के लिए किसी निवासी ठेकेदार को भुगतान करने वाला व्यक्ति स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

धारा 194C के तहत वैधानिक सीमाएँ निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. एकल अनुबंध भुगतान ₹30,000 से अधिक हो, अथवा
2. वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान ठेकेदार को किए गए भुगतानों का कुल योग ₹1,00,000 से अधिक हो।

चूँकि ₹40,000 का अनुबंध भुगतान ₹30,000 की व्यक्तिगत सीमा से अधिक है, इसलिए DDO को धारा 194C के तहत TDS काटना अनिवार्य है (यदि ठेकेदार व्यक्तिगत/HUF है तो 1% की दर से, अथवा अन्य संस्थाओं के लिए 2% की दर से)।

अन्य धाराएँ:
- धारा 192 वेतन भुगतान पर लागू होती है।
- धारा 194J व्यावसायिक या तकनीकी सेवाओं के शुल्क पर लागू होती है।
- धारा 194A प्रतिभूतियों पर ब्याज से इतर अन्य ब्याज पर लागू होती है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the remittance and filing of TDS by Government Offices:
I. Government deductors are permitted to remit deducted TDS to the credit of the Central Government without the production of an income-tax challan through a Book Adjustment.
II. When TDS is remitted via Book Adjustment, the concerned Pay and Accounts Officer (PAO) or Treasury Officer must file Form 24G to the agency authorized by the DGIT (Systems).
III. Government offices and educational institutions are exempt from filing quarterly TDS returns.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english:
Statement I is correct: Under Rule 30(1) of the Income Tax Rules, where tax has been deducted by or on behalf of the Government, it may be remitted to the credit of the Central Government on the same day through book adjustment (transfer entry) without producing an ITNS 281 challan.
Statement II is correct: Under Section 200(2A) and Rule 31A(1)(a), whenever tax is credited to the Central Government by book adjustment without challan, the PAO, Treasury Officer, or designated accounting authority must file a monthly statement in Form 24G by the 10th of the following month (or 30th April for March). This generates a Book Identification Number (BIN) for each DDO.
Statement III is incorrect: Government offices are NOT exempt from filing quarterly TDS returns. The school DDO is statutorily mandated to file Form 24Q/26Q every quarter, quoting the Book Identification Number (BIN) received from the PAO/Treasury in place of the bank challan BSR code and CIN.
Thus, only Statements I and II are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
कथन I सही है: आयकर नियम, 1962 के नियम 30(1) के अनुसार, सरकारी विभागों एवं कार्यालयों द्वारा काटा गया टीडीएस बिना किसी बैंक चालान (ITNS 281) के सीधे बही समायोजन (Book Adjustment/Transfer Voucher) द्वारा उसी दिन केंद्र सरकार के खाते में जमा कराया जा सकता है।
कथन II सही है: आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 200(2A) तथा नियम 31A के तहत, बुक एडजस्टमेंट से कर जमा होने पर संबंधित वेतन एवं लेखा अधिकारी (PAO) या कोषागार अधिकारी को प्रत्येक माह की 10 तारीख तक 'फॉर्म 24G' दाखिल करना होता है, जिससे संबंधित डीडीओ के लिए बुक आइडेंटिफिकेशन नंबर (BIN) जनरेट होता है।
कथन III गलत है: किसी भी सरकारी कार्यालय या विद्यालय को त्रैमासिक टीडीएस रिटर्न (Form 24Q/26Q) दाखिल करने से कोई छूट प्राप्त नहीं है; डीडीओ को बैंक चालान के स्थान पर कोषागार से प्राप्त BIN का उपयोग करते हुए अनिवार्य रूप से त्रैमासिक रिटर्न दाखिल करना होता है।

questions.question_english: A school audit notes that several teacher entries in the latest Form 24Q are marked as "PAN Invalid" due to clerical data entry errors by the DDO. What is the immediate consequence of this error on the concerned employees?
options_english: The employees' personal bank accounts will be immediately frozen by the tax department.
The employees will face immediate criminal prosecution for willful tax evasion.
The deducted TDS will not reflect in their Form 26AS/AIS, preventing them from claiming tax credit when filing their annual ITR.

questions.explanation_english: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) is strictly mapped and credited in the Income Tax Department's central database using the employee's 10-character Permanent Account Number (PAN). If the DDO enters an invalid or erroneous PAN in Form 24Q, the Central Processing Cell (CPC-TDS) cannot map the tax payment to the employee's tax ledger. Consequently, the deducted tax fails to appear in the employee's Form 26AS and Annual Information Statement (AIS). When the employee files their Income Tax Return (ITR), the tax department's automated system disallows the TDS credit claim, resulting in an unjustified tax demand notice with interest under Section 234B/234C. To resolve this, the DDO must immediately file a C3 correction statement on TRACES to update the valid PAN.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत पर काटा गया कर (TDS) आयकर विभाग के केंद्रीय डेटाबेस में कर्मचारी के 10-अंकीय स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) के आधार पर ही क्रेडिट होता है। यदि डीडीओ फॉर्म 24Q में गलत या अमान्य पैन दर्ज कर देता है, तो CPC-TDS उस कटौती को कर्मचारी के कर खाते से नहीं जोड़ पाता। इसके परिणामस्वरूप, वेतन से काटा गया टीडीएस कर्मचारी के 'फॉर्म 26AS' और 'वार्षिक सूचना विवरण' (AIS) में प्रदर्शित नहीं होता। जब कर्मचारी अपना वार्षिक आयकर रिटर्न (ITR) दाखिल करता है, तो कर क्रेडिट उपलब्ध न होने के कारण पोर्टल पर कर मांग (Tax Demand Notice) निकल आती है। इसे सुधारने के लिए डीडीओ को ट्रेसेस पर C3 शुद्धि विवरणी (Correction Statement) दाखिल करनी पड़ती है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following administrative actions undertaken by a school Principal regarding financial compliance and tax rules:
I. Applying for a Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) immediately upon being designated as a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) for a newly opened school.
II. Refusing to issue Form 16 to a teaching staff member on the grounds that their quarterly TDS return had already been successfully accepted and processed by TRACES.
III. Verifying the active GSTIN and statutory filing status of a supplier prior to procuring interactive smart panels worth ₹5,00,000 on the GeM portal.
IV. Stating clearly in the student fee circular that core educational curriculum services provided by the school are exempt from GST under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate).
Which of the actions listed above reflect correct and statutory compliant administrative behavior?
options_english: I and III only
I, III, and IV only
II and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: Actions I, III, and IV represent correct, legally compliant administrative behavior, whereas Action II is a serious statutory violation. Under Section 203A of the Income Tax Act, 1961, every person deducting tax must obtain a TAN. Under Section 203 read with Rule 31, an employer is legally obligated to furnish Form 16 (Part A downloaded from TRACES and Part B) to every salaried employee from whom tax has been deducted by 15th June; merely filing the quarterly return does not absolve the DDO of this obligation, and failure to issue Form 16 attracts a statutory penalty of ₹500 per day under Section 272A(2)(g). Checking vendor GST credentials on GeM (Action III) complies with General Financial Rules (GFR) to avoid fraudulent billing. Notifying GST exemption on core education under Entry 66 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) (Action IV) ensures administrative transparency. Therefore, I, III, and IV are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: कार्यवाही I, III और IV विधिसम्मत और सही प्रशासनिक आचरण को दर्शाती हैं, जबकि कार्यवाही II कानून का गंभीर उल्लंघन है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 203A के तहत कर कटौती करने वाले प्रत्येक DDO के लिए TAN प्राप्त करना अनिवार्य है। धारा 203 एवं नियम 31 के अनुसार, जिस कर्मचारी का टीडीएस काटा गया है, उसे 15 जून तक फॉर्म 16 (TRACES से डाउनलोड किया गया भाग A तथा नियोक्ता द्वारा तैयार भाग B) जारी करना नियोक्ता का सांविधिक दायित्व है; केवल रिटर्न दाखिल कर देने से DDO इस दायित्व से मुक्त नहीं हो जाता (फॉर्म 16 जारी न करने पर धारा 272A(2)(g) के तहत ₹500 प्रतिदिन का जुर्माना लग सकता है)। GeM पोर्टल पर ₹5 लाख के सामान की खरीद से पहले विक्रेता के GST पंजीकरण का सत्यापन (III) और शुल्क परिपत्र में शिक्षा पर जीएसटी छूट (अधिसूचना 12/2017 के तहत) का पारदर्शी उल्लेख (IV) वित्तीय शुचिता के अनुकूल हैं। अतः केवल I, III और IV सही हैं।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following transactions:
I. Opening a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA)
II. Depositing cash exceeding ₹50,000 with a banking company during any one single day
III. Sale or purchase of a motor vehicle other than a two-wheeler
According to Rule 114B of the Income Tax Rules, 1962, quoting of Permanent Account Number (PAN) is mandatory for which of the transactions listed above?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english:
Rule 114B of the Income Tax Rules, 1962 mandates quoting of PAN for specified financial transactions:
1. Opening a bank account: While opening an account with a banking company or cooperative bank generally requires PAN, Rule 114B explicitly carves out an exception for a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan account). Therefore, quoting PAN is NOT mandatory for opening a BSBDA (Statement I is incorrect).
2. Cash deposits: Quoting PAN is mandatory for deposit of cash exceeding ₹50,000 during any one single day with a banking company or cooperative bank (Statement II is correct).
3. Motor vehicles: Quoting PAN is mandatory for the sale or purchase of any motor vehicle or vehicle, other than two-wheeled vehicles (Statement III is correct).
Therefore, quoting PAN is mandatory for transactions II and III only.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर नियम, 1962 का नियम 114B विनिर्दिष्ट वित्तीय लेन-देन के लिए पैन (PAN) उद्धृत करना अनिवार्य बनाता है:

questions.question_english: What is the tax implication under the Income Tax Act if a teacher surrenders their earned leaves (Leave Encashment) while in active service (not at the time of retirement or superannuation)?
options_english: It is fully exempt from income tax.
It is taxable only if the total encashment amount exceeds ₹3,00,000.
It is taxed under the head 'Income from Other Sources'.

questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 10(10AA) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, statutory tax exemption on leave encashment applies exclusively to sums received by an employee at the time of retirement, superannuation, or resignation/termination of service:
1. For Central and State Government employees, leave encashment received at the time of retirement is 100% exempt from income tax under Section 10(10AA)(i).
2. However, any leave encashment received by an employee (whether government or non-government) while continuing in active service is treated as 'profits in lieu of salary' under Section 17(1)(va) and is fully taxable under the head 'Income from Salaries'. No statutory exemption is available for in-service leave encashment (though the employee may claim tax relief under Section 89).
Therefore, in-service leave encashment is fully taxable under Income from Salaries.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 10(10AA) के अनुसार, अवकाश नकदीकरण (लीव इनकैशमेंट) पर कर छूट केवल सेवानिवृत्ति (रिटायरमेंट), अधिवर्षिता (सुपरएंनुएशन) या सेवामुक्ति के समय प्राप्त राशि पर ही उपलब्ध होती है:
1. सरकारी कर्मचारियों को सेवानिवृत्ति के समय प्राप्त अवकाश नकदीकरण धारा 10(10AA)(i) के तहत पूरी तरह कर-मुक्त होता है।
2. परंतु, यदि कोई कर्मचारी (चाहे वह सरकारी हो या गैर-सरकारी) सेवा में रहते हुए (In-service) अर्जित अवकाश का नकदीकरण कराता है, तो यह धारा 17(1)(va) के तहत वेतन का हिस्सा माना जाता है और 'वेतन से आय' शीर्ष के अंतर्गत पूर्णतः करयोग्य (Fully Taxable) होता है। इसके लिए धारा 10(10AA) के तहत कोई छूट नहीं मिलती। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: If an employee's Permanent Account Number (PAN) becomes 'inoperative' due to non-linking with Aadhaar, what is the immediate legal consequence regarding TDS deduction on their salary by the employer (DDO)?
options_english: TDS will not be deducted at all until the PAN is linked
The employee is deemed to have failed to furnish a PAN, attracting a higher TDS rate of 20% under Section 206AA
TDS is deducted at normal rates, but the employee is barred from claiming an income tax refund
The employee faces immediate deemed suspension from service under Conduct Rules
questions.explanation_english:
Under Rule 114AAA(3) of the Income Tax Rules, 1962 and CBDT Circular No. 03/2023 dated March 28, 2023, where a person's PAN has become inoperative due to failure to link it with Aadhaar:
1. The PAN holder is treated as if they have not furnished or quoted the PAN for all provisions of the Act.
2. Consequently, under Section 206AA, tax must be deducted at source at a higher rate (i.e. at 20% or the applicable rate, whichever is higher).
3. Furthermore, no tax refunds will be issued for inoperative PANs, and no interest is payable on refunds under Section 244A for the inoperative period.
Therefore, the DDO is legally obligated to deduct TDS at the higher rate of 20% under Section 206AA.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर नियम, 1962 के नियम 114AAA(3) और सीबीडीटी (CBDT) परिपत्र संख्या 03/2023 (दिनांक 28 मार्च 2023) के अनुसार, यदि आधार से लिंक न होने के कारण किसी व्यक्ति का पैन 'निष्क्रिय' हो जाता है:
1. उस व्यक्ति को आयकर अधिनियम के समस्त प्रावधानों के लिए पैन प्रस्तुत न करने वाला (Non-furnishing of PAN) माना जाता है।

questions.question_english: A government school procures examination printing services worth ₹60,000 from a commercial vendor. The vendor fails to furnish a valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) to the school's DDO. In accordance with Section 206AA of the Income Tax Act, 1961, at what rate must the DDO deduct TDS?
options_english: 1% flat rate on the total contract value
2% flat rate on the total contract value
10% flat rate on the aggregate invoice value
20% or the applicable statutory rate, whichever is higher
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 206AA of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any person entitled to receive any sum or income on which tax is deductible at source (the deductee) must furnish their Permanent Account Number (PAN) to the deductor (the DDO).
If the deductee fails to furnish their PAN, the tax must be deducted at the highest of the following rates:
1. At the rate specified in the relevant provision of the Act (for contractual printing under Section 194C, normally 1% for individual/HUF and 2% for others);
2. At the rate or rates in force; or
3. At the rate of twenty per cent (20%).
Therefore, because 20% is higher than the standard 1% or 2% rate under Section 194C, the DDO is legally bound to withhold tax at 20% or the applicable rate, whichever is higher.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 206AA के अनुसार, जिस व्यक्ति को ऐसा कोई भुगतान प्राप्त होना है जिस पर स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) देय है, उसके लिए कटौतीकर्ता (DDO) को अपना स्थायी खाता संख्या (PAN) प्रस्तुत करना अनिवार्य है।
यदि प्राप्तकर्ता अपना पैन प्रस्तुत करने में विफल रहता है, तो DDO को निम्नलिखित में से जो भी उच्चतम हो, उस दर से टीडीएस काटना होगा:
1. अधिनियम के संबंधित प्रावधान में विनिर्दिष्ट दर पर (धारा 194C के तहत मुद्रण अनुबंध पर सामान्य दर व्यष्टि/HUF के लिए 1% और अन्य के लिए 2% है);
2. लागू वित्त अधिनियम में प्रभावी दर पर; अथवा
3. बीस प्रतिशत (20%) की दर पर।
अतः DDO को 20% या लागू दर, जो भी अधिक हो, पर टीडीएस काटना अनिवार्य है।

questions.explanation_english:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (SCSP) [now known as the Scheduled Caste Development Action Plan - SCDAP] and the Tribal Sub-Plan (TSP) [now Development Action Plan for Scheduled Tribes - DAPST] were initiated by the Planning Commission in the 1970s to ensure that targeted, non-divertible budgetary allocations proportionate to the population of SCs and STs are spent directly on their socio-economic, educational, and infrastructural development.

These public finance and planning mechanisms are administrative operationalizations of Article 46 of the Constitution, which directs the State to promote with special care the educational and economic interests of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes and protect them from social injustice.

Regarding the other options: Article 17 deals with the abolition of untouchability; Article 338 provides for the National Commission for Scheduled Castes; and Article 341 empowers the President and Parliament to specify the list of Scheduled Castes.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अनुसूचित जाति उप-योजना (SCSP) [वर्तमान में अनुसूचित जाति विकास कार्य योजना - SCDAP] तथा जनजातीय उप-योजना (TSP) [वर्तमान में जनजातीय विकास कार्य योजना - DAPST] योजना आयोग द्वारा 1970 के दशक में शुरू की गई विशेष वित्तीय रणनीतियां हैं। इनका उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि केंद्रीय और राज्य बजट का एक निश्चित अनुपात (उनकी जनसंख्या के अनुपात में) विशेष रूप से एससी और एसटी समुदायों के प्रत्यक्ष सामाजिक, शैक्षणिक और आर्थिक विकास पर व्यय किया जाए।

यह बजटीय एवं प्रशासनिक रणनीति सीधे तौर पर संविधान के अनुच्छेद 46 के अधिदेश को क्रियान्वित करती है, जो राज्य पर यह कर्तव्य डालता है कि वह विशेष सावधानी से अनुसूचित जातियों और अनुसूचित जनजातियों के शैक्षणिक व आर्थिक हितों की उन्नति करे।

questions.question_english: If a government school teacher is posted in a remote hilly area and receives a Special Compensatory (Hill Areas) Allowance, under which section of the Income Tax Act, 1961, is it eligible for partial tax exemption?
options_english: Section 10(10)
Section 10(14)
Section 10(5)
Section 16(ii)
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 10(14)(ii) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 read with Rule 2BB(2) (Item 1 in the Table) of the Income-tax Rules, 1962:
1. Special compensatory allowances granted to employees posted in designated high-altitude, difficult, or remote hilly areas (such as the Special Compensatory Hill Areas Allowance) are eligible for partial tax exemption.
2. The statutory exemption limit ranges from ₹300 to ₹7,000 per month depending on the altitude and designated composite area/category.
Other provisions:
- Section 10(10) governs exemptions on gratuity.
- Section 10(5) governs Leave Travel Concession (LTC).
- Section 16(ii) provides statutory deductions for entertainment allowance for government employees.
Thus, Section 10(14) is the correct section.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 10(14)(ii) तथा आयकर नियम के नियम 2BB(2) के अंतर्गत:
1. विशिष्ट दूरस्थ, उच्च-पर्वतीय या कठिन परिस्थितियों वाले क्षेत्रों में सेवा करने के कारण दिए जाने वाले विशेष प्रतिपूरक भत्ते (जैसे Hill Areas Allowance / High Altitude Allowance) आंशिक आयकर छूट के लिए पात्र हैं।

अन्य विकल्पों में:
- धारा 10(10) उपदान (ग्रेच्युटी) से संबंधित है।
- धारा 10(5) अवकाश यात्रा रियायत (LTC) से संबंधित है।
- धारा 16(ii) सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए मनोरंजन भत्ते की कटौती से संबंधित है।
अतः सही उत्तर धारा 10(14) (विकल्प B) है।

Under Section 10(1) of the POSH Act, 2013, the Internal Committee or Local Committee may, before initiating an inquiry under Section 11 and exclusively at the request of the aggrieved woman, take steps to settle the matter between her and the respondent through conciliation.

Crucial Statutory Features of Section 10 Conciliation:
1. Voluntary Complainant-Driven Process: Conciliation cannot be imposed or coerced by the employer, Principal, or ICC members. It is strictly optional and triggered solely upon the woman's request.
2. Timing: It can only take place before initiating the formal departmental/statutory inquiry.
3. Statutory Boundary: Section 10(1) proviso explicitly prohibits any monetary settlement from serving as the basis of conciliation.
4. Consequence: Where conciliation succeeds and a settlement is recorded, no further inquiry is conducted (Section 10(4)).

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the recovery and payment of compensation under the POSH Act, 2013:
I. The Act provides for deduction of the compensation amount directly from the salary or wages of the respondent.
II. If the employer is unable to make deductions due to the respondent's absence from duty or cessation of employment, the respondent may be directed to pay the amount directly to the aggrieved woman.
III. If the respondent fails to pay the directed sum, the Internal Committee may forward the recovery order to the District Officer to recover it as an arrear of land revenue.
IV. Compensation awarded to the aggrieved woman must always be funded directly by the employer from institutional funds rather than recovered from the respondent.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I, II, and III only
III and IV only
II, III, and IV only
questions.explanation_english:
Under Section 13(3)(ii) of the POSH Act, 2013, when allegations of sexual harassment are proved, the Internal Committee recommends deduction of the compensation sum from the respondent's salary or wages (Statement I is correct).
The proviso to Section 13(3) explicitly stipulates that:
1. If the employer is unable to make such deductions from the respondent's salary due to absence from duty or cessation of employment, the employer may direct the respondent to pay such sum directly to the aggrieved woman (Statement II is correct).
2. If the respondent fails to pay the sum, the Internal Committee may forward the recovery order to the District Officer, who shall recover the amount as an arrear of land revenue under the relevant Revenue Recovery Act (Statement III is correct).
Statement IV is incorrect because compensation is a personal statutory liability of the perpetrator (respondent) and is never legally mandated to be paid out of the employer's institutional/corporate funds. Thus, Statements I, II, and III are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
पॉश अधिनियम, 2013 की धारा 13(3)(ii) के अनुसार, लैंगिक उत्पीड़न के आरोप सिद्ध होने पर आंतरिक समिति प्रतिवादी के वेतन अथवा पारिश्रमिक से मुआवजे की राशि की कटौती की सिफारिश करती है (कथन I सही है)। धारा 13(3) के परंतुक (proviso) के अनुसार:
1. यदि प्रतिवादी की कार्य से अनुपस्थिति अथवा सेवा समाप्ति के कारण नियोक्ता वेतन से कटौती करने में असमर्थ है, तो नियोक्ता प्रतिवादी को उक्त राशि सीधे पीड़िता को भुगतान करने का निर्देश दे सकता है (कथन II सही है)।
2. यदि प्रतिवादी इस राशि का भुगतान करने में विफल रहता है, तो आंतरिक समिति इस आदेश को जिला अधिकारी (District Officer) को अग्रेषित कर सकती है, जो इसे भू-राजस्व के बकाए (arrears of land revenue) की भांति वसूल करेगा (कथन III सही है)।
कथन IV गलत है क्योंकि मुआवजा प्रतिवादी (दोषी व्यक्ति) के व्यक्तिगत दायित्व के रूप में वसूला जाता है, नियोक्ता के संस्थागत कोष से नहीं। अतः केवल कथन I, II और III सही हैं (विकल्प B)।

questions.explanation_english: 'Quid pro quo' is a Latin phrase meaning 'something for something'. In workplace harassment jurisprudence and under Section 3(2)(i)-(iii) of the POSH Act, 2013, quid pro quo harassment occurs when employment opportunities, salary increments, favorable performance appraisals, promotions, or job retention are made contingent upon an employee's submission to sexual advances or requests for sexual favours. If the victim complies, benefits are promised; if she refuses, detrimental treatment or termination is threatened. This differs from a 'hostile work environment', which involves a general pervasive atmosphere of offensive or sexually charged conduct.

questions.question_english: Under the POCSO Act, 2012, which statutory authority is primarily responsible for providing free legal assistance and assigning a legal counsel to the child victim?
options_english: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
The School Management Committee (SMC)
The local Bar Association on a voluntary pro-bono basis only
The Police Department
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 40 of the POCSO Act, 2012 read with Rule 8 of the POCSO Rules, 2020, a child victim or their legal guardian is entitled to legal representation throughout the pre-trial and trial proceedings. Where the family or guardian is unable to engage a private legal practitioner, the Special Juvenile Police Unit (SJPU), the Child Welfare Committee (CWC), or the Special Court is mandated to inform and request the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), constituted under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987. The DLSA holds the statutory responsibility to provide free, competent legal aid and appoint a designated empanelled legal advocate to assist the child during police investigation, statement recording under Section 164 CrPC, and courtroom proceedings.
questions.explanation_hindi: पॉक्सो अधिनियम, 2012 की धारा 40 तथा पॉक्सो नियमावली, 2020 के नियम 8 के अंतर्गत पीड़ित बालक और उसके परिवार को कानूनी प्रतिनिधित्व का अधिकार प्राप्त है। यदि पीड़ित बालक का परिवार निजी अधिवक्ता रखने में असमर्थ है, तो बाल कल्याण समिति (CWC), विशेष किशोर पुलिस इकाई (SJPU) अथवा विशेष न्यायालय द्वारा 'जिला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण' (DLSA) को सूचित किया जाता है। विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण अधिनियम, 1987 के अंतर्गत गठित DLSA का यह सांविधिक दायित्व है कि वह पीड़ित बालक को निःशुल्क, सक्षम विधिक सहायता प्रदान करे और जांच, धारा 164 CrPC के तहत बयान दर्ज कराने तथा विशेष न्यायालय में सुनवाई के दौरान बालक का पक्ष रखने हेतु एक योग्य पैनल अधिवक्ता नियुक्त करे। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
